name: skill-immo
description: Skill apartment-search: find flats for sale in France around an address, a street or a neighborhood, enriched with open data (DVF sales, DPE, risks, condominiums, shops, travel times, crime, income) and the Stream Estate API, in a local dashboard with price and negotiation, building, neighborhood, budget and follow-up

stream_estate_api_key.title: Stream Estate API key
stream_estate_api_key.description: Optional: listings from every portal, asking-price analytics, reconciled sales and alerts by Stream Estate (paid per use, 0.01 € a credit). Empty: open data and assisted listings (WebSearch, WebFetch, pasted text)
